Bindings without a basis entry are pure field/param reads (`ordered`, `panel`, `specimen`, `fasting`). - reissue: `MX(14, …) + carried` matches "never below 14 days before the carried-over days are added, and the carried-over days are added last"; `int(remaining/2)` = round down for remaining ≥ 0. Rule's retained base sentence "an expiring kit is reissued only within the panel's requisition validity" has no compute counterpart (observation O3).

Connective "only after"; waited-on state record-visible (`lab_orders.membership_id`); no tool/id/snake_case; the only write of this difficulty that sets `membership_id` is the correction (no base path-change tool exists; the correction's overwrite routes this exact case to the in-place move). Derivation: sentence → order is self_pay/list_price with `membership_id` empty while a membership was in force on `ordered_date` → the correction rule's own subject ("posted on the self_pay path although its patient held a qualifying membership … moved in place to the member_rate path with that membership recorded on it") → correction write. Single reading in worlds where the membership is still in force today; **two readings / unsatisfiable when the membership was in force on the ordered date but is not today** (RED-P5).
- phlebotomy: "The home-visit charge for an order whose requisition expires within 14 days of the switch date is not fixed until the order's requisition carries a reissue." Connective "not … until"; state `reissue_count ≥ 1`; only the reissue write raises it; the reissue window (base: no more than 14 days before expiry and not after) coincides with the engaged set, and `requisition_reissues_allowed` = 1 for every panel, so the edge is satisfiable whenever engaged and unmet (an order already reissued satisfies the sentence). Single reading. PASS.
- Neither depended-on rule restates the sentence; no other cross-problem order sentence found in any rule. Base rule sentences ground no edge.

### findings
Every RED below is charter-global; the task files demonstrate the per-world consequence where one exists.

- **RED-P1 (SOURCE-POLICY, XF C2) unscoped price overwrite.** Symptom: `lab_ext_member_rate_correction.overwrite[0].replaced_by`: "Larkspur Health's published price of a panel charged on the self_pay or member_rate path is the panel's tier price plus the specimen handling charge plus the specimen courier charge plus the partner lab processing charge, each fixed as this rule states." The superseded clause is the base self_pay/member_rate price clause in full; replaced_by names no scope and does not restate base for out-of-scope orders. Consequence: every self_pay and member_rate panel charge in the scenario is now list/member price + three surcharges, so (a) the base `lab_ordered → lab_panel_charged` pricing is retired for all orders; (b) own-category history must be priced that way — task0's seeded self_pay STI line (129.00, base price) is not producible (in-force price 129.00+6.00+3.00+5.00=143.00), task1's member_rate CMP line (31.00) is producible only on an unstated as-of date (see RED-P5). Bears on tasks 0 and 1.
- **RED-P2 (SOURCE-POLICY, undeclared override / dropped branch).** Base `lab_evt_payment_path`: "Second, membership_included: the patient holds a membership, and either the tier's member_price_by_membership_tier for the panel is 0.00 or lab_msr_included_used_year is below included_per_membership_year_by_tier." Extended correction: "When the order was posted on the self_pay path although its patient held a qualifying membership on the ordered date, the order is moved in place to the member_rate path" — carving out only "a panel that the qualifying membership includes at a member price of 0.00". Same situation (Plus Monthly/Annual member, Comprehensive Wellness Panel, included 1 per year unused, posted self_pay): base → membership_included, correct panel price 0.00, billing_error refund of the whole panel charge; extended → member_rate at 139.00+surcharges, partial refund. Neither task world is on this branch (no per-task score consequence); the charter conflict stands.
- **RED-P3 (SOURCE-POLICY, undeclared conflict with a base parameter meaning, XF C1).** `parameter_schema.at_home_kit_fee`: "Fee for an at-home collection kit including return shipping." Kit rule: "The kit return pack added to the switch charge … the multi-specimen return pack charge … the priority return charge …" — return shipping charged twice; not named in any overwrite. Bears on task0 (STI → multi-specimen return pack).
- **RED-P4 (SOURCE-POLICY, one quantity defined three ways + sibling mirroring, AMENDMENT 1).** Kit: "the full draw fee standing on the order" = `SUM(psc_draw_fee lines)` (no netting). Phlebotomy: "The draw fee standing on the order is its patient service center draw fee lines less the billing_error refunds booked on the order." Reissue: "The patient service center draw fee standing on the order is its draw fee lines less the billing_error refunds booked on the order." On task1's order the gross figure is 16.00 and the netted figure 8.00. The netted definition also subtracts billing_error refunds of other lines (e.g. the panel-line refund the correction policy itself writes): a corrected order with a 36.00 panel refund and an 8.00 draw line has "draw fee standing" −28.00 → no credit / "no draw fee stands". The same draw-fee line is credited on the kit switch at full ≤30 days / less 2.9 %+0.30 at 31–60 / nothing, and on the phlebotomy switch at full ≤45 / less 2.00 at 46–90 / nothing. Bears on task1 (phlebotomy credit and reissue fasting reserve read the netted definition) and task0 (kit credit reads the gross one).
- **RED-P5 (SOURCE-POLICY, XF A9 as-of date + D1 edge scope).** (a) Correction rule: "held a qualifying membership on the ordered date. A qualifying membership is the patient's membership whose status is trialing, active or past_due …" — the compute reads today's `status`; the kit prerequisite sentence says "held a membership that was trialing, active or past due on its ordered date". A membership active on the ordered date and cancelled since: kit sentence engaged and waits; correction compute `qualifies` False → the correction rule does not apply → the kit switch can never be fixed (D1: unsatisfiable when engaged). (b) specimen_handling: "when the order carries a patient service center draw fee line" — as of the charge date or today is unstated; task1's order had no draw line on its 2026-08-10 posting date and has one now (27.00+0.00+1.50=28.50 vs 27.00+2.50+1.50=31.00).
- **RED-P6 (SOURCE-POLICY, XF B6 framing clause).** "(a suspended_date on or before the ordered date together with a current_period_start after the ordered date shows a suspension that lasted past it)" — false whenever the membership was suspended, reactivated before the ordered date and has since renewed (every monthly tier renews monthly; annual tiers yearly): e.g. suspended 2026-05-01, reactivated 2026-05-05, order 2026-06-10, current_period_start 2026-07-05 → the test reports a suspension over 2026-06-10 that the records do not show, and the correction is refused. Neither task world is on this branch.
- **RED-P7 (SOURCE-POLICY, XF B2 first-match read with no selection rule).** Unkeyed `CFIELD('membership', …)` with rule words "the patient's membership": correction (`mem_status`, `mem_activated`, `mem_suspended`, `mem_period_start`, `mem_tier`), reissue (`member_tier`, `member_clinician`; rule states no status condition at all), phlebotomy (`mob_tier`, `mob_status`). The membership charter allows a cancelled earlier membership plus a current one ("A patient may hold only one Larkspur membership at a time", rejoin_fee_waiver_days). With a cancelled Plus record listed first and a current Essentials record second, the correction reads the cancelled record (not qualifying → out of scope) while the rule ("the patient's membership whose status is trialing, active or past_due") selects the Essentials one; the reissue grants the Plus extension from a cancelled membership. Each task world holds one membership (no per-task score consequence).
- **RED-F1 (SOURCE-FACTOR, mislabelled method).** specimen_handling: tiers "the handling charge per specimen times the three specimens" (2.00×3), "one flat blood handling charge" (2.50), 0.00 — three constants, a `parameter`. carried_over_days: "all the days left" vs "half the days left, rounded down" — the same input under a constant multiplier. Correction and reissue are left with no honest `method` factor.
- **RED-F2 (SOURCE-FACTOR, dead tiers → fewer than three real tiers).** fasting_slot_premium tier "the panel needs 1 to 7 fasting hours" (catalogue fasting_hours: A1c 0, Lipid 9, CMP 8, Thyroid 0, STI 0, Wellness 9); serum_handling_charge tier "the panel's specimen is urine, swab and blood" (STI Screening Panel; its collection_methods_available is patient_service_center, at_home_kit — no mobile phlebotomy); carried_over_days fall-through "otherwise … no days are carried over" (the base window allows a reissue only "no more than requisition_reissue_window_days calendar days before its requisition_expiry_date and not after it", 14 for every panel, so remaining ∈ [0,14] at every reissue — the factor's baseline 0 is a tier no reissuing customer is on). Bears on task1.
- **RED-F3 (SOURCE-FACTOR, conditions no business in the line weighs).** specimen_courier, kit_dispatch_zone, home_visit_zone are keyed on `visit_appointments.patient_location_state` (schema: "State where the patient said they would physically be during the visit") although the specimen, the kit and the phlebotomist go to the home address (`customers.home_state`, "this is the residence state, not necessarily where the patient is located during a visit"); partner_lab_processing keys the lab's processing charge on the ordering visit type; fasting_reserve_days shortens requisition validity by fasting hours and by whether a draw fee "stands". Bears on tasks 0 and 1 (in both worlds visit state = home state, so the scored value does not separate the two keys — the ladder is unreal regardless).
- **RED-F4 (SOURCE-FACTOR, X5 invented fees).** older_order_handling (8.00/4.00 for an order 46+/15–45 days old), weekend_dispatch (Saturday pickup 12.00, Sunday 8.00 keyed on the call date), dispatch_notice_tier (25.00/10.00 keyed on days to requisition expiry rather than appointment lead), requisition_paperwork (4.00 near / 2.00 far for a requisition that "carries a reissue"). Bears on tasks 0 and 1.
- **RED-F5 (SOURCE-FACTOR, realism bar R2 "one timing schedule per date dimension").** Phlebotomy: dispatch_notice_tier and requisition_paperwork both key the change-date → requisition_expiry_date span (paperwork reuses `notice_mid_days`), as does the ≥2-day clause of fasting_slot_premium. Kit: older_order_handling (ordered_date → change date) and prior_collection_credit (draw-fee charge_date → change date; the draw fee is charged at ordering, so the same span — 51 days in task0 for both). Bears on tasks 0 and 1.

Observations (not grounds for rework): O1 gendered general text ("herself", "her own"); O2 unused `membership_id` args; O3 reissue rule retains "an expiring kit is reissued only within the panel's requisition validity" with no compute counterpart; O4 base names no refund_reason for a method-change refund, while phlebotomy's "mobile phlebotomy fee standing" nets only cancelled_before_collection refunds (task1's seed labels its method-change refund cancelled_before_collection); O5 Premier outbound reduction vs "Membership pricing never reduces a collection fee"; O6 kit_return_pack "no kit fee line yet" holds of almost every PSC→kit switch (counts a refunded kit line from an earlier kit→PSC change).

## post_reveal_addendum (revision_1; written after both task freezes and the reveal)
Source: the instantiator worklog's charter-wide tables (factor / A6 / B2 probe / residue sections), read only after the freeze as the brief allows.
- **RED-F6 (SOURCE-FACTOR, realism bar AMENDMENT 1 condition 6 and preference order).** The worklog tags no factor `R6`, gives no record key / "why no R1–R5 lever could take the slot" line for any of them, and records instead: "specimen handling, courier, processing, return pack, dispatch zone, older-order handling, weekend dispatch, reissue levers and home-visit charges are Larkspur-published schedule items added to meet the drawn factor counts on a thin charter". Every factor that is not an R1–R5 lever of the frozen charters is therefore an untagged R6 factor failing condition 6: specimen_handling, specimen_courier, partner_lab_processing, kit_return_pack, prior_collection_credit, kit_dispatch_zone, older_order_handling, weekend_dispatch, fasting_reserve_days, dedicated_clinician_extension, order_urgency_cut, carried_over_days, fasting_slot_premium, home_visit_zone, dispatch_notice_tier, prior_draw_credit, serum_handling_charge, requisition_paperwork (18 of 21). Graded R1–R5: membership_tier_pricing (R1 catalogue), kit_outbound_shipping (R1, rx shipping schedule reused), clinical_currency_cut (R2 requisition-expiry schedule on the ordering-visit age). AMENDMENT 1 step 1 lists lab levers the charter already names (panel price by tier / plan / path, collection-method fees, requisition expiry); the worklog does not record why they could not fill the slots.
- Worklog B2 table confirms RED-P7: "CFIELD membership (patient) | second cancelled membership | not seeded; rule reads the patient's membership; single record" — the decoy probe was not run, and no selection rule exists.
- Worklog A6 table confirms RED-F1: specimen_handling "per-specimen (count x unit)" — the count is the constant `multi_specimen_count` 3.
- Worklog "Residue / decisions" and task 1's design_rationale ("refund_reason has no method-change value … BLUEPRINT-KNOWN gap 1") confirm O4.
